results.title: ZooWork: The AI agent delivery platform for FDEs and domain experts | Product Hunt
results.content:
Since then, we've heard one thing over and over, and felt it ourselves: there are countless tools for building AI agents, but almost nothing for delivering them. Everyone has an agent that works beautifully on their laptop. Almost no one can hand it to a client, a team, or a paying user as a reliable service.

That gap changed what we build, and our name along with it. ZooWork is our answer: an agent delivery platform for forward-deployed engineers, developers, and domain experts, with the whole path from build to production in one place.

Build: Describe what you want in the no-code Builder, or stay in the coding agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, and more) and ship through our Managed Agent API. Setup is one line:

`npx skills add SerendipityOneInc/zoowork-sdk-skills` [...] ZooWork

I love the product concept.

Imagine a founder could build an agent that drafts investor updates from approved company notes, then share it with teammates for review, that will be very helpful.

David Lu

@justin2025 The approved notes are what make this work, since an update is only as good as what the founder has already signed off on. You'd load those notes into the Agent's knowledge base, write the update format and tone into its job description, and set it to run on a monthly schedule. The draft then goes to your teammates through a share link or Slack, and they review it before anything reaches investors. The knowledge base is free on ZooWork for a limited time, so it's a good moment to try it with last month's notes and see whether the draft sticks to them.
